pathways.title: Associate
pathways.description: Build consistent Go implementation habits from programming basics through standard library fluency.
pathways.level_outcome: You can implement small-to-medium Go functions with clear contracts, edge-case coverage, and readable tests.

pathways.title: Engineer
pathways.description: Shift from isolated functions to boundary-aware service code, testing discipline, and debugging skills.
pathways.level_outcome: You can build and debug boundary-heavy Go code with explicit error handling and reliable runtime behavior.

pathways.title: Senior
pathways.description: Master concurrency, reliability patterns, advanced data structures, and production security practices.
pathways.level_outcome: You can design, debug, and evolve senior-level Go solutions with strong operational and maintainability standards.

pathways.title: Lead
pathways.description: Apply production-grade quality standards, testing discipline, and architectural reasoning across complete systems.
pathways.level_outcome: You can apply production-grade quality standards and design tradeoff reasoning to professional Go solutions.
